b: The English publication of Ryuichi Sakamoto's memoir, Music Sets you Free, coincides with an exhition at Hamburger Bahnhof in Berlin. Together, they prove a fitting testament to one of the great musical minds of the twentieth century
Portrait of Ryuichi Sakamoto © 2020 KAB Inc. , Photo: Neo Sora

Ryuichi Sakamoto’s first memoir, Music Sets You Free, sees four banal words recalling the old John Miles hit from 1976, that cheesy overblown pop tune (you know the one) with its line about music being his first love and last. “Music of the future, music of the past”. Trite for sure, but simultaneously – annoyingly – honest and true. Sakamoto likewise was never afraid of romantic cliché. The book underlines his passions and...
